g.text: GDHUB-117 — day 1: the goal is read after payment, 24 hours to adjust

text.tspan: Purchase: the author writes only the goal,
picks the curator, pays
(no AI call before payment — pro or AI)
Pro: the checkpoint starts on the day of call 1;
the goal and tasks open for that day's 24 hours
Call 1 inside the 24 hours:
the author adjusts the goal and tasks on the call or after it
The checkpoint starts;
the goal and tasks open for 24 hours
The curator reads the goal once:
does it fit 28 days and the team's hours?
First letter: "Your plan looks good — go ahead!"
and until when it can still be adjusted
First letter: the doubts, task by task,
and what to change by <time>
The first letter without the read;
the read is tried again when the author opens day 1

g.text: The author is told: the curator wrote, 24 hours to adjust

text.tspan: /workflow/cp{N}/review/1
the author edits the goal and the tasks

g.text: On save: advice on the tasks, as today

text.tspan: The goal and tasks lock;
the tasks open again after the sprint 2 review, as today

g.text: No model call before payment: nobody who does not buy costs anything
The read is written once per checkpoint, however many times the payment webhook fires
AI: 24 hours from payment, or from the start day the author picked if later. Pro: the 24 hours of call 1's day — a call late in the day leaves little time after it
The purchase terms say the opposite today ("the AI checks your draft before you pay", "2 days"): they need a new version
